$comment: LICENSE-PENDING — see docs/non_ratified/LICENSE_PENDING.md. LoopDraft per LOOP_ENGINEERING_SPEC_V2.1 §2.1 (mutable authoring state) and §15 (draft revision + concurrency contract). Cross-references, does not redefine: semantic-digest.v1.json (exclusionListV1 — presentation/layout metadata), loop-validation-rules.v1.json (validationState.findings[].code), loop-definition.v2.schema.json (the `graph` field's EMBEDDED mode is loosely typed on purpose — see that field's description for why a draft is deliberately NOT required to validate against the strict LoopDefinition schema at every autosave point). LOOP_PHONE_AUTHORING_SPEC.md §13's DRAFT_CLEAN/DIRTY_JOURNALED persistence state machine and §8's BASE_REVISION/PROPOSED/APPLIED/DISCARDED AI-proposal machine are phone-surface UI states layered on top of this wire object, not restated here — this schema models the durable LoopDraft object and its concurrency contract, not either UI state machine.
title: LoopDraft
description: Mutable authoring state with stable draft identity, revision, graph, presentation/layout metadata, validation state, test workspace reference, source surface, and local history (§2.1). A draft is not trusted or publishable until packaged (LOOP_ENGINEERING_SPEC_V2.1 §20). This file also defines, as sibling top-level $defs, the draft-revision/concurrency contract (§15): DraftMutationRequest (a proposed mutation against an expected revision) and DraftMutationConflictReport (the semantic-conflict rejection a stale mutation MUST receive — never last-write-wins).

draftId.description: Stable draft identity, never reused after deletion (§14, §2.1). This schema cannot enforce non-reuse (that is a store-level obligation over time, not a single-document structural property).

revision.description: Monotonically increasing revision counter. Every mutation is applied against an expected revision (§15) — see DraftMutationRequest below.

presentation.description: Draft-level presentation/layout metadata (viewport, card collapse state, etc.) — named after and excluded by the same key names semantic-digest.v1.json's exclusionListV1 drops from a packaged LoopDefinition's semantic digest ('presentation', 'layout', 'x', 'y', 'notes'). A draft's own graph.definition (when embedded) carries its own per-node presentation/notes fields per loop-definition.v2.schema.json; this top-level field is draft-surface-wide state (e.g. current Stage View scroll position) that has no per-node home at all.

testWorkspaceRef.description: A test/fixture workspace bundle for this draft, reused as-is from schemas/common/artifact-ref.schema.json (not redefined here) — same cross-file $ref pattern schemas/execution/receipt.schema.json and schemas/devices/firmware-artifact.schema.json already use for a byte artifact reused wholesale. Null before any simulation/replay has produced a workspace.

sourceSurface.description: FB-RAT-LBX-001/§2.1: which authoring surface currently owns this draft. Phone and browser drafts do not silently merge (§15) — an explicit import/fork/comparison/selected-change application is the only bridge (LOOP_DUAL_SURFACE_ARCHITECTURE.md §11).

localHistory.description: §15: append-only local history of revisions. Each entry records actor class, timestamp, base/resulting semantic digest, operation list, validation state, and authority/verification delta.

unknownFields.description: Bag for fields a decoder received but did not recognize, preserved for round-trip (FB-RAT-COM-003).

ActorClass.description: §15's exact actor-class vocabulary, the same one LOOP_FORK_LINEAGE_CONTRACT.md §3 reuses for lineage events (a lineage event and a draft revision are the same kind of fact, per LOOP_ENGINEERING_SPEC_V2.1 §15).

SemanticDigestString.description: semantic-digest.v1.json's output format: 'sha256:<lowercase-hex>' over definition.json minus exclusionListV1, per the fb-loop-canon-1 canonicalization profile. Not recomputed or verified by this schema.

mode.description: EMBEDDED: the graph is authored inline in this draft. REFERENCED: this draft tracks an already-packaged/installed LoopDefinition it was forked from (§11 'imported packages remain editable on the phone through a forked draft'; FB-RAT-IMP-006 'editing an installed release creates a forked local draft rather than mutating it') — the draft has not yet diverged into its own embedded graph.

definition.description: Required (non-null) when mode=EMBEDDED (enforced below). Deliberately loosely typed here (a free-form object, NOT $ref'd against loop-definition.v2.schema.json's strict required-field list): a LoopDraft is explicitly 'not trusted or publishable until packaged' (§2.1) and is expected to be structurally incomplete for long stretches of an authoring session (e.g. mid-edit with no terminalNodeIds yet). validationState below is the honest signal of whether `definition` currently satisfies loop-definition.v2.schema.json in full — a build step (§20 step 2, 'validate the semantic graph') is what actually re-validates `definition` against that strict schema before a package may be produced; this schema does not pre-empt that step by rejecting legitimately in-progress drafts.

referencedDefinitionRef.description: Required (non-null) when mode=REFERENCED (enforced below) — the release identity tuple subset (§14) this draft was forked from or is tracking against (LOOP_FORK_LINEAGE_CONTRACT.md §10's 'immutable snapshot' comparison target).

code.description: A stable code from loop-validation-rules.v1.json's namespace architecture (§19), e.g. 'LOOP-GRAPH-002'. Not cross-checked against the live registry by this schema — a code matching the pattern but not present in the registry is a validator-time error, not a schema one.

rulesetVersion.description: loop-validation-rules.v1.json's `rulesetVersion` ('fb-loop-validation-rules-1') in effect when `findings` was produced.

ValidationState.description: A validator MUST NOT report status=VALID while `findings` contains an ERROR-severity entry — this schema does not enforce that cross-field agreement structurally (status and findings are independent properties); see fixtures/loops/loop-draft/adversarial/ for the resulting schema-valid-but-dangerous case this leaves open.

AuthorityVerificationDelta.description: §15 'authority/verification delta' — the draft-revision-time echo of the same two blocking conditions LOOP_FORK_LINEAGE_CONTRACT.md §9 (FB-RAT-LIN-005) evaluates at lineage-comparison time.

idempotencyKey.description: FB-RAT-COM-006: SHOULD be present so a retried journal write (LOOP_PHONE_AUTHORING_SPEC.md §13 DIRTY_JOURNALED) is not double-applied.

DraftRevisionRecord.description: §15's exact revision-record shape: actor class, timestamp, base semantic digest, resulting semantic digest, operation list, validation state, authority/verification delta.

expectedRevision.description: §15: 'Every draft mutation is applied against an expected revision.' A mutation whose expectedRevision does not match the draft's current `revision` MUST be rejected with a DraftMutationConflictReport, never applied last-write-wins.

DraftMutationRequest.description: §15's draft-revision/concurrency contract, request side. A conforming store either applies this and appends a DraftRevisionRecord with revisionNumber = expectedRevision + 1, or rejects it with a DraftMutationConflictReport — there is no third outcome.

conflictingRevisions.description: The revision(s) applied between expectedRevision and actualRevision — what the stale mutation did not see.

DraftMutationConflictReport.description: §15: 'A stale mutation is rejected with a semantic conflict report; it is not last-write-wins.' actualRevision MUST differ from expectedRevision for this report to be meaningful — a validator, not this schema (JSON Schema draft 2020-12 has no keyword comparing two sibling integer properties for inequality), enforces actualRevision != expectedRevision.
